_about: The kits and guides on the website (https://models.tech-box.io). kits: by the name in their page's address (/kits/<name>/): name and code as shown, folder = the kit folder the guides are generated in. guides: by the name in their web address (https://models.tech-box.io/<name>/: lower-case words joined by hyphens; once an address is in the LMS it must not change): kit, steps = that guide's steps file in the kit folder (a Part or a deconstruction guide gets its own, e.g. steps-part-1.json; all the guides of a kit share the kit's model.glb), label = how its card names it on the kit page (Full Build, Part 1, Deconstruction ...), script = what makes the steps file if not guide.py. The order here is the order on the pages. embed_origins: the only sites that may show a guide in a frame (render.yaml says the same). Publish with: python3 tools/publish.py <name> --note "...".
